description: Add health, library-path, and refresh-status discovery needed to verify user-visible media availability.
acceptance: Adapter reports health and library visibility without persisting media titles.
Synthetic fixtures prove healthy, unreachable, and partial states.
The adapter reuses transport-01 for endpoint policy, credentials, retries, typed failures, and redaction rather than implementing a private HTTP stack.
Fast synthetic fixture tests and a focused real-container jellyfin lane both pass.
Read-only operation performs no domain mutation; any required authentication session is explicitly classified and side-effect-free.
